pdn_default_workflow:
name: PDN official published berth plans
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      probe_only:
        description: Read one official day without publishing an edition
        type: boolean
        default: false
  schedule:
    # 08:45 Vietnam; actual cron acceptance requires real scheduled evidence.
    - cron: '45 1 * * *'
permissions:
  contents: write
concurrency:
  group: pdn-plans-staging
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: codex/cloudflare-next-compat
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        if: ${{ !inputs.probe_only }}
        with:
          path: .local/pdn
          key: pdn-public-v1-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          restore-keys: pdn-public-v1-
      - name: Read official source
        env:
          PROBE: ${{ inputs.probe_only }}
        run: |
          if [ "$PROBE" = "true" ]; then
            DAY=$(TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date -d yesterday +%F)
            python scripts/collect-pdn-plans.py --from "$DAY" --to "$DAY"
          else
            python scripts/test-pdn-plans.py
            FROM=$(TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh date -d "7 days ago" +%F)
            python scripts/collect-pdn-plans.py --from "$FROM"
            python scripts/export-pdn-plans.py
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: ${{ !inputs.probe_only }}
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: ${{ !inputs.probe_only }}
        run: corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - if: ${{ !inputs.probe_only }}
        run: pnpm exec vitest run tests/pdn-plans.test.ts tests/pdn-history.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && pnpm typecheck
      - name: Publish validated edition
        if: ${{ !inputs.probe_only }}
        run: |
          git add packages/modules/port/src/pdn-history-data.ts packages/modules/port/src/pdn-journal-loader.ts packages/modules/port/src/pdn-journal-data docs/catalog-review/pdn-history-ledger.json
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
            git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
            git commit -m 'data(ports): refresh PDN official published berth plans'
            git pull --rebase origin codex/cloudflare-next-compat
            git push origin HEAD:codex/cloudflare-next-compat
          fi
      - name: Reconcile deployed edition
        if: ${{ !inputs.probe_only }}
        run: node scripts/verify-pdn-live.mjs
      - uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        if: ${{ always() && !inputs.probe_only }}
        with:
          path: .local/pdn
          key: pdn-public-v1-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pdn-readback
          path: .local/pdn/*receipt.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
